items.claim: Carlsberg Britvic announced a 10-year partnership with The Rivers Trust to restore rivers, wetlands and floodplains near its Rugby site, stating an aim to replenish 100% of the water consumed there by 2032.
items.source: Carlsberg Group newsroom release; Paul Davies, CEO of Carlsberg Britvic, quoted saying "Water is at the heart of every drink we make, so protecting this precious resource is not only important for our business, it's a responsibility we take seriously."

items.claim: Mark Lloyd said the summer was a stark reminder that water cannot be taken for granted, citing record UK temperatures and the impact of pollution and drought on rivers, in the same partnership release.
items.source: Mark Lloyd, CEO of The Rivers Trust

items.claim: 'This is an important milestone in our long-term commitment to Kazakhstan, but it is also a major step in the development of our business across Central Asia' - sagt i forbindelse med aabningen af Carlsberg Kazakhstans nye braggeri, som selskabet beskriver som et regionalt produktions- og forsyningsknudepunkt for Centralasien.
'Investments of this scale are only possible when businesses have confidence in long-term partnership and stability.'

Business Today skrev, at Carlsberg India har faaet SEBI's godkendelse af sin fortrolige IPO-ansoegning og dermed er rykket taettere paa en boersnotering, og at detaljer om stoerrelse og tidspunkt foerst kommer naar dokumenterne offentliggoeres.
